scope.summary: Implement diagram generation into whiteboard mode via the model-steerable command surface: board/diagram structures (flowcharts, mind maps, matrices, stickied breakdowns) generated from a prompt or from existing canvas content, expressed as a StudioCommandBatch that mints board objects through node-factory commands, so a generated diagram is ONE reviewable, promotion-gated, undoable proposal authored under a KernelActor model identity - never an unaudited direct board mutation. Model board ops (summarize stickies, cluster/sort, ideate) are ordinary commands inheriting receipting + quiet-law. Native to kernel model lanes, no hosted board-AI dependency.
acceptance_criteria: diagram/board generation as one promotion-gated undoable proposal; model board ops receipted; no hosted AI dep
proof_targets: diagram-gen as single promotion-gated proposal test
expected_tests: live: generate a flowchart as one StudioCommandBatch proposal (promotion-gated, undoable)
live: summarize-stickies board op runs as ordinary receipted commands
negative: generation never writes board authority directly

risk_if_missed: Generated diagrams bypass the proposal/promotion lifecycle; unaudited board mutation.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
